title: Route (automated playtest script)
description: A scripted walkthrough of a dialogue path, used for regression testing. Steps are executed in order via the playSession engine; assertions are checked against the final game state.

seed.description: RNG seed for the play session. Defaults to 0.

startSnapshot.description: Id of a snapshot to start from. Its state is the base; startState (if also present) overlays it per top-level field.

startState.description: Partial game state to start from. Omitted fields default to zero/empty.

relationships.description: characterId → starting standing. Absent characters start at 0.

steps.description: Ordered steps: choices to make, a cutscene to consume between scenes, or a choiceless 'advance' run.

oneOf.description: Make a choice at the current node.

choiceId.description: ID of the choice to select at the current node.

forced.description: Force an active check to pass or fail instead of rolling.

continuation.description: If set, the runner calls nextContinuations after the current dialogue ends and picks the continuation matching this dialogueId before making this choice.

oneOf.description: Consume the pending cutscene between scenes: apply effectsOnComplete, clear pendingCutscene, enter entersDialogue if present.

cutscene.description: The cutscene id, which must match state.pendingCutscene.

oneOf.description: Walk N consecutive next-advances (choiceless, N2) from the current node — collapses a long ambient/narration run into one step instead of one synthetic-choice step per beat. Fails if the current node has no 'next' at any hop.

advance.description: Number of consecutive advance() calls this step performs. Typically 1.

assertEnd.description: Assertions checked against the final game state after all steps complete.

flags.description: Each key must equal the specified boolean in the final state.

questStages.description: Each quest must be at the specified stage in the final state.

forbiddenFlags.description: These flags must NOT be set (truthy) in the final state.

endingAvailable.description: This ending's unlockedBy condition must evaluate true against the final state.

pendingCutscene.description: Cutscene id expected in state.pendingCutscene at route end. Use null to assert none pending.

relationships.description: characterId → exact expected standing at route end. An unadjusted character is 0.
